forum.title: ST67W611M1: measure frequency of external 32.768 kHz crystal oscillator circuit
forum.best_answer_content:
Hi @PKR

The 32 kHz clock signal cannot be routed on a GPIO to perform such measurement.

Regards
forum.content_text:
Dear all,

is it possible to measure the frequency of the 32,768kHz oscillator (external crystal used) at a buffered pin similar to the MOC pin of the STM32 to tune the frequency by the external capacitors? It would be difficult to do this at pin XTAL32k\_IN/OUT without influencing the oscillator frequency.

Best regards,

Peter
forum.author: PKR

scraped_replies.html: There is a divided output  - check you processor data sheet
scraped_replies.author: mbarg.1

scraped_replies.html: I could't finde any hint in the ST67W611M1 module / QCC743 SoC datasheets. Could you provide details?
scraped_replies.author: PKR

scraped_replies.html:
Hi @PKR 

The 32 kHz clock signal cannot be routed on a GPIO to perform such measurement.

Regards
